messages:
sam: FYI PR #842 (optkit/docs) merged but CI flagged two broken links and a short-seq quant profile example that gives wrong output for sequence length < 8. Can we triage quickly?

docs-bot: CI failure summary: linkcheck error (404) on /optimize/kv-prefetch and unit test 'shortseq_quant_profile' failed.

maya: I can take the link fixes. Which URLs? I saw one was an old internal gist.

sam: Thanks. The two are: https://docs.redwood.ai/optkit/kv-prefetch -> should be /optimize/kv-prefetch and an internal gist https://gist.github.com/redwood/old-kv-examples -> replace with repo snippet https://github.com/redwood/inference-examples/optkit/kv-prefetch.py

pranav: I’ll look at the quant profile. Reproduced failure: for seq=4 it returns truncated logits; seems we applied 16-bit quant profile that's for long sequences. Need a short-seq profile or guard in example.

lina: We should add a note in the migration guide about short vs long seq defaults. Quick patch in docs would prevent confusion.

trent: Suggestion: modify the example code to pick profile by input length. Small snippet:

```python
# choose quant profile based on input len
if len(prompt_tokens) < 8:
    quant_profile = 'shortseq-q4'
else:
    quant_profile = 'longseq-q4_1'
```

pranav: That looks good. I'll add a unit test to the docs examples runner to cover seq=4 and seq=32.

maya: I'll open a follow-up PR for links (target: #845). Sam, can you add the migration-note bullet? I can add the redirect for the internal gist.

sam: On it. I'll add migration bullet and also update the console link in the example to the public Console route.

maya: PR #845 opened: fixes links + redirects. cc @sam @pranav

pranav: Patch for quant profile prepared locally, running tests. ETA 2h.

trent: QA plan: docs reviewer + run examples in the examples runner on x86 GPU (shortseq smoke). I'll do the QA after pranav's tests.

lina: Add a small paragraph to migration guide: why shortseq profile needed and how to choose thresholds. I'll draft and push into #845 as a docs-only commit if okay.

sam: please do. If we can get all merged today we avoid a revert/rollback cycle.

maya: Linkfix CI passed. waiting on pranav.

pranav: Tests passed locally, pushing PR #846 with quant profile change and docs note. Includes unit test.

docs-bot: PR #846 opened by pranav. CI checks queued.

trent: I'll run manual smoke after CI green. If green, we merge both #845 and #846 together and cherry-pick to stable branch.

maya: ack. tagging release-cues.

sam: thanks everyone. follow-up: add a one-line blurb in release notes about "optkit: short-sequence quant profile guidance + link fixes".

lina: done, added to draft release notes.

pranav: CI green and merged. #846 merged.

maya: #845 merged. all green. :tada: 

sam: Great. Closing loop: I updated the migration guide with thresholds and moved the kv-prefetch snippet to examples repo. Thanks all.

lina: small follow-up: can we add an optkit e2e test for shortseq in next sprint? filing ticket.

sam: filed ticket INF-1283. ok to close.

maya: closing thread. :wave:
